context: Documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on postwar development.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; vocabulary (発展/戦後/われわれ/自ら/思想) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦後、国はどう発展したんですか?
lines.en: How did the nation develop after the war?
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: われわれの先人が、自ら立て直しました。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい思想も、発展を支えたんですか?
lines.en: Did new ideologies support the development?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、自由の思想が広がりました。
lines.en: Yes, the ideology of freedom spread.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: われわれは、そこから何を学べますか?
lines.en: What can we learn from that?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 自ら考え、自ら動くことの大切さです。
lines.en: The importance of thinking and acting for ourselves.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 戦後の発展は、努力の結果ですね。
lines.en: The postwar development was the result of effort.
lines.style: understanding young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: われわれも、その思想を受け継ぎたいですね。
lines.en: We too want to inherit that ideology.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
